verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document date-range/recency filters (e.g. `pd` for last 24 hours, 'powerful date-based filtering'), news search for real-time articles, and claims of a frequently crawled/indexed billion-page index ensuring freshness. Missing for 10: independent/third-party benchmarking of index freshness or update frequency, and no explicit documentation of the full set of date-range operators beyond the 24-hour example.
